hints.title: Abbreviation Collision Resolution
hints.text: Words of the same length and matching first and last characters can collide under the initial abbreviation scheme.

hints.title: Prefix Length Incrementing
hints.text: Start every word with prefix of length 1. For any duplicate abbreviations, increment prefix lengths of conflicting words until distinct.

hints.title: Grouped Conflict Resolution
hints.text: Group indices by their generated abbreviation string. For groups with size > 1, increment prefix length k for all words in the group and recompute abbreviation. Repeat until all abbreviations are distinct.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Grouped resolution recomputes abbreviations up to word length L.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise string comparisons without grouping leads to redundant O(N^2 * L) work.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map grouping collisions isolates updates only to conflicting subsets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Iteratively extend prefix lengths for collision groups.
